title: When spending outgrows income
literal_meaning: Like the temple’s front hall exceeding the temple itself.
explanation: The dictionary explicitly applies this architectural comparison to expenditure exceeding income. What should be a supporting part has grown beyond the thing that supports it. The image asks us to notice proportion in a plan, especially when its surrounding costs threaten to consume more than the available means.
meaning_odia: ଦେଉଳଠାରୁ ତାର ସାମନା ମଣ୍ଡପ ବଡ଼ ହୋଇଯିବାର ତୁଳନା ଏଠି ଆସିଛି। ଅଭିଧାନ ଏହାକୁ ଆୟଠାରୁ ବ୍ୟୟ ବଢ଼ିଯିବା ସହ ଯୋଡ଼ିଛି। ମୂଳ କାମ ପାଇଁ ଯେତିକି ସମ୍ବଳ ଅଛି, ତାଠାରୁ ଆୟୋଜନର ଖର୍ଚ୍ଚ ବଢ଼ିଗଲେ ଅନୁପାତଟି ବିଗିଡ଼ିଯାଏ।
english_summary: The dictionary explicitly applies this architectural comparison to expenditure exceeding income.
